traits.capitulum_kind.note: FNA's account of the genus: each head usually has white ray florets round its disc, rarely none.

traits.disc_florets.note: FNA's account of the genus: 120 to 200 or more yellow disc florets in a head.

traits.phyllaries.note: FNA's account of the genus, as search results quote copies of its text (the pages themselves were not read): involucres hemispheric or broader, 12 to 35 mm across or more; phyllaries persistent, 35 to 60 or more in 3 to 4 or more rows.

traits.phyllary_series.note: FNA's account of the genus, as search results quote copies of its text (the pages themselves were not read): phyllaries in 3 to 4 or more rows.

traits.receptacle.note: FNA's account of the genus, as search results quote copies of its text (the pages themselves were not read): receptacles convex, without scales (epaleate).

traits.receptacle_shape.note: FNA's account of the genus, as search results quote copies of its text (the pages themselves were not read): receptacles convex.

traits.pappus.note: FNA's account of the genus: the ribbed fruits bear no pappus.
